finalText:
I made the headlines bigger on 4 of the 5 artboards: Welcome, GitHub, Local and Success. The Hub artboard is still waiting.

**Why Hub is waiting:** another AI run is working on that artboard right now. All five headlines share one style rule in `Onboarding.css`, so I didn't change that rule, because it would have changed Hub too. Instead I gave the four free headlines their own size class. Once that run finishes, Hub can get the same change: add `className="ob-h1--up"` to its `<h1>`.

**What "one step bigger" means here:** the headlines were already at `--type-3xl` (34px), the largest size in the maude type scale. There's no bigger size to step up to. So I used the scale's own ~1.2 ratio and set them to about 41px, with line height increased by the same ratio to 48px. That size isn't a design-system token. If you'd rather it be one, add a `--type-4xl` token to the maude system and switch these headlines to it.

**Checked:** I took screenshots of all four changed artboards. They came out small, so I couldn't check fine detail, but every headline shows larger, sits on one line and doesn't overlap anything. I didn't run `maude design check` myself; the automatic check on each save didn't reject any edit.

**Left alone:** the locked "Choose a folder…" button on Local, and the left-rail lede ("Design together…"), which is styled as text rather than a headline.
